description: Planar truss in the XY plane: top and bottom chords, verticals and diagonals in Warren, Pratt or Howe layout, swept with a steel I-section or a square timber section. Spans x = -span/2 … span/2. Pivot at the centre of the bottom chord's underside. Pieces: truss_chords, truss_web (steel or wood_dark). Every member is closed.

height.desc: depth of the truss, chord centre to chord centre (m)

panels.desc: panels along the span (even counts are symmetric)

params.code:
const L = span, H = height, y0 = member_size / 2;
for (const y of [y0, y0 + H]) addprim(0, 'polyline', [addpoint(0, [-L / 2, y, 0]), addpoint(0, [L / 2, y, 0])]);

web_lines.note: warren: alternating diagonals; pratt: verticals + diagonals sloping down to the middle; howe: verticals + diagonals sloping up to the middle

i_section.note: unit I-section (flange width 1, depth 1) in the XY plane

section.note: sweep maps profile x to the in-plane side of the member and profile y to +Z: turn the I so its depth lies in the truss plane
